rows.label: ROUGH
rows.clue: The part of a golf course bordering the fairway where the grass is not cut short

rows.label: AIR SPACE

rows.label: BUFFER STATE

rows.label: ANTIPODES

rows.label: INNER CITY

rows.label: THICK
rows.clue: The location of something surrounded by other things

rows.label: TOWNSHIP

rows.label: ECLIPTIC
rows.clue: The great circle representing the apparent annual path of the sun

rows.label: CHECKPOINT
rows.clue: A place (as at a frontier) where travellers are stopped for inspection and clearance

rows.label: PUBLIC SQUARE
rows.clue: An open area at the meeting of two or more streets

rows.label: TOUCHLINE
rows.clue: Either of the sidelines in soccer or rugby

rows.label: OUTSKIRTS
rows.clue: Outlying areas (as of a city or town)

rows.label: PRIME MERIDIAN
rows.clue: Meridian at zero degree longitude from which east and west are reckoned (usually the Greenwich longitude in England)

rows.label: TAX HAVEN
rows.clue: A country or independent region where taxes are low

rows.label: COUNTY
rows.clue: (United Kingdom) a region created by territorial division for the purpose of local government

rows.label: ASCENDING NODE
rows.clue: The point at which an orbit crosses the ecliptic plane going north

rows.label: FLEA MARKET
rows.clue: An open-air street market for inexpensive or secondhand articles

rows.label: FIRESIDE
rows.clue: An area near a fireplace (usually paved and extending out into a room)

rows.label: TIME ZONE
rows.clue: Any of the 24 regions of the globe (loosely divided by longitude) throughout which the same standard time is used

rows.label: CAMPING AREA
rows.clue: A site where people on holiday can pitch a tent

rows.label: TRAIL HEAD
rows.clue: The beginning of a trail

rows.label: OVERLOOK
rows.clue: A high place affording a good view

rows.label: CITY BLOCK
rows.clue: A rectangular area in a city surrounded by streets and usually containing several buildings

rows.label: POSITION
rows.clue: The particular portion of space occupied by something

rows.label: LURKING PLACE
rows.clue: A place suitable for lurking

rows.label: DANGER ZONE
rows.clue: A dangerous area

rows.label: SAVANNA
rows.clue: A flat grassland in tropical or subtropical regions

rows.label: ISOTHERM
rows.clue: (meteorology) an isogram connecting points having the same temperature at a given time

rows.label: SOLAR APEX
rows.clue: The point on the celestial sphere toward which the sun and solar system appear to be moving relative to the fixed stars

rows.label: OUTLINE
rows.clue: The line that appears to bound an object

rows.label: PROVENANCE
rows.clue: Where something originated or was nurtured in its early existence

rows.label: WATERMARK
rows.clue: A line marking the level reached by a body of water

rows.label: DATE LINE
rows.clue: An imaginary line on the surface of the earth following (approximately) the 180th meridian

rows.label: BUS ROUTE
rows.clue: The route regularly followed by a passenger bus

rows.label: TESTING GROUND
rows.clue: A region resembling a laboratory inasmuch as it offers opportunities for observation and practice and experimentation

rows.label: HARBOR
rows.clue: A sheltered port where ships can take on or discharge cargo

rows.label: PRECINCT
rows.clue: A district of a city or town marked out for administrative purposes

rows.label: DEEP SPACE
rows.clue: Any region in space outside the solar system

rows.label: GREENBELT
rows.clue: A belt of parks or rural land surrounding a town or city

rows.label: HILLTOP
rows.clue: The peak of a hill

rows.label: CORN COB
rows.clue: The hard cylindrical core that bears the kernels of an ear of corn

rows.label: SILHOUETTE
rows.clue: An outline of a solid object (as cast by its shadow)

rows.label: BUILDING SITE
rows.clue: A lot on which there are no permanent buildings

rows.label: EXTREME POINT
rows.clue: The point located farthest from the middle of something

rows.label: GHOST TOWN
rows.clue: A deserted settlement (especially in western United States)

rows.label: STAR SIGN
rows.clue: (astrology) one of 12 equal areas into which the zodiac is divided

rows.label: MOTHER COUNTRY
rows.clue: The country where you were born

rows.label: OUTER SPACE
rows.clue: Any location outside the Earth's atmosphere

rows.label: SHEIKDOM
rows.clue: The domain ruled by a sheik

rows.label: WHEAT FIELD
rows.clue: A field planted with wheat

rows.label: SETTING
rows.clue: The context and environment in which something is set

rows.label: POLE POSITION
rows.clue: The most favorable position at the start of a race

rows.label: OUTSKIRT
rows.clue: A part of the city far removed from the center

rows.label: ZODIAC
rows.clue: A belt-shaped region in the heavens on either side to the ecliptic

rows.label: TIDAL ZONE
rows.clue: An area subject to tidal action

rows.label: COASTLINE
rows.clue: The outline of a coast

rows.label: JUNK PILE
rows.clue: An accumulation of refuse and discarded matter

rows.label: GOLDFIELD
rows.clue: A district where gold is mined

rows.label: BARRIO
rows.clue: A Spanish-speaking quarter in a town or city (especially in the United States)

rows.label: MIDAIR
rows.clue: Some point in the air

rows.label: BAILIWICK
rows.clue: The area over which a bailiff has jurisdiction

rows.label: STRING LINE
rows.clue: Line across a billiard table behind which the cue balls are placed at the start of a game

rows.label: PERIGEE
rows.clue: Periapsis in Earth orbit

rows.label: ORBIT
rows.clue: The (usually elliptical) path described by one celestial body in its revolution about another

rows.label: STATE CAPITAL
rows.clue: The capital city of a political subdivision of a country

rows.label: BUFFER ZONE
rows.clue: A neutral zone between two rival powers that is created in order to diminish the danger of conflict

rows.label: TOP SIDE
rows.clue: The highest or uppermost side of anything

rows.label: CROSS SECTION
rows.clue: A section created by a plane cutting a solid perpendicular to its longest axis

rows.label: WATERSHED
rows.clue: A ridge of land that separates two adjacent river systems

rows.label: OUTBACK
rows.clue: The bush country of the interior of Australia

rows.label: BREADBASKET
rows.clue: A geographic region serving as the principal source of grain

rows.label: RESORT HOTEL
rows.clue: A hotel located in a resort area

rows.label: STATE
rows.clue: The territory occupied by one of the constituent administrative districts of a nation

rows.label: DISTRICT
rows.clue: A region marked off for administrative or other purposes

rows.label: GOAL LINE
rows.clue: A line marking each end of the playing field or pitch

rows.label: ROTTEN BOROUGH
rows.clue: An English parliamentary constituency with few electors

rows.label: MIDPOINT
rows.clue: A point equidistant from the ends of a line or the extremities of a figure

rows.label: APPROACH PATH
rows.clue: The final path followed by an aircraft as it is landing

rows.label: STRIKE ZONE
rows.clue: (baseball) the area over home plate between a batter's knees and shoulders through which a pitch must pass in order to be called a strike

rows.label: ASTEROID BELT
rows.clue: The region of interplanetary space between Mars and Jupiter where most asteroids are found

rows.label: AEROSPACE
rows.clue: The atmosphere and outer space considered as a whole

rows.label: ARCHBISHOPRIC
rows.clue: The territorial jurisdiction of an archbishop

rows.label: POLLING PLACE
rows.clue: A place where voters go to cast their votes in an election

rows.label: BOUNDS
rows.clue: The line or plane indicating the limit or extent of something

rows.label: NAVEL POINT
rows.clue: The center point or middle of something

rows.label: FAIRWAY
rows.clue: The area between the tee and putting green where the grass is cut short

rows.label: OPEN AIR
rows.clue: Where the air is unconfined

rows.label: HORIZON
rows.clue: The line at which the sky and Earth appear to meet

rows.label: EARSHOT
rows.clue: The range within which a voice can be heard

rows.label: MOORING
rows.clue: A place where a craft can be made fast

rows.label: HIDING PLACE
rows.clue: A place suitable for hiding something (such as yourself)

rows.label: REGION
rows.clue: The extended spatial location of something

rows.label: PUBLIC HOUSING
rows.clue: A housing development that is publicly funded and administered for low-income families

rows.label: MIDDEN

rows.label: ROOFTOP
rows.clue: The top of a (usually flat) roof

rows.clue: A commercially operated park with stalls and shows for amusement
